connector.name: Halal Terminal
connector.registryDescription: Shariah-compliant stock and ETF screening across AAOIFI, DJIM, FTSE, MSCI and S&P methodologies.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.halalterminal.com over server sent events, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.halalterminal, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
